trials.claim: Purchased Premium models never expire and can be edited and replaced anytime without limitations
trials.claimQuote: Purchased Premium models never expire and you can edit and replace them at any time w/o limitations
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit mentions limited viewer controls as a Premium feature, but it does not address whether purchased models expire or whether editing and replacing them is limited.

exhibits.quote: UI needs some work to display models seamlessly on Wordpress site, but it's less troublesome than expected, especially when the controls are limited (Premium feature).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows controls are limited even as a Premium feature, contradicting without limitations.

trials.claim: Lifetime hosting, embedding and AR viewing of purchased 3D models
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime hosting and embedding and AR viewing of your purchased 3D models
trials.reasoning: Reviews confirm many options for embedding models and sharing them online or in AR with a few clicks. The storage-stacking exhibit does not contradict lifetime hosting, embedding, or AR viewing.

exhibits.quote: and the ability to stack extra codes for more storage (up to 10) made scaling my projects straightforward and affordable.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows hosting/storage is capped at up to 10 stacks, undermining unlimited lifetime hosting.

exhibits.quote: There are tons of options for sharing and embedding the models into your website.
exhibits.argument: This confirms embedding and sharing of models works as promised for hosting.

exhibits.quote: I love that I can share my 3D models online or in AR with just a few clicks.
exhibits.argument: This confirms online sharing and AR viewing of models works as promised.

trials.claim: Max model size is 300 MB for purchased models and 100 MB for free models
trials.claimQuote: Max. Model Size: 300 MB for your purchased model, 100 MB for your free models
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about maximum model sizes for purchased or free models.

trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about the $59 price or the $500 regular price.

trials.claim: No app install required for interactive 3D and AR experiences
trials.claimQuote: Interactive 3D Experiences & Augmented Reality - no app install required
trials.reasoning: A review describes the viewer as browser-based, allowing models to be uploaded, viewed, and embedded without downloads, supporting no app install required.

exhibits.quote: P3D.IN is a browser-based 3D model viewer for easy sharing. Upload, view, and embed models without downloads.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the viewer works in browser without downloads, supporting no app install required.

trials.claim: Visitors can view life-like 3D models and scan a QR code to view in AR
trials.claimQuote: Engage your website visitors with life-like 3D models and/or let them scan a QR code to view in AR
trials.reasoning: A review says QR-to-AR is not native and requires manually adding /ar/ to the link and generating the QR code on another site, materially limiting the claimed scan-a-QR-code-to-view-in-AR experience.

exhibits.quote: Another way it could be improved is to make the qr code generator native, and add an option for augmented reality (and not have to manually add /ar/ to the link and generate the qrcode on another site).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows QR code AR viewing requires manual link editing and external site, undermining easy scan QR claim.

exhibits.quote: They use the markerless technology to project augmented reality, which is the latest technology; however, it might be useful to make augmented reality available through markers, to reach some specific projects and older devices.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows AR does not reach older devices and specific projects, undermining universal AR viewing claim.

exhibits.quote: the options to deepen the model with textures, metadata, display styles, QR codes and hotspots.
exhibits.argument: This confirms QR codes are available for models to support AR viewing.

exhibits.quote: The AR mode works great too - thumbs up!
exhibits.argument: This confirms AR viewing works as promised for buyers.

themes.summary: Many buyers say the viewer is easy to use, fast, and works well for sharing and embedding 3D and AR models.

hits.quote: The software itself works great as well.
The upload and sharing process is incredibly simple, and the viewer is smooth and responsive even on mobile.
Its user-friendly tools make it incredibly easy to start building exciting projects, even for beginners.
is probably the fullest featured 3d / AR editor and viewer I've experienced.
The app is fantastic for people wanting to venture into AR/3D without much experience
It's just an amazing product.
For someone who is totally new to this space was really easy to set up and use.
made an account, and was editing and hosting my avatars 5 MINUTES LATER!
I was still able to quickly upload models, add textures, create variants, hotspots, etc.
This is a great service for sharing 3D models.
The website is very user-friendly and easy to use
uploaded in a breeze and worked seamless in AR using my ipad.
It's very easy-to-use software, letting creatives worry about what interests them most: creativity, not programming.
It's an excellent tool to show clients a 3D Model of properties for sale.
With this software, images and logos can pop from the page
Quickly, beautifully display your 3D models.

themes.summary: Several buyers praise fast, helpful support from Hans and clear documentation.

hits.quote: Customer support and documentation are clear, and the embed options let me showcase models seamlessly across websites and presentations.
Plus, their customer service is top-notch and always there to help.
The online reviews and support here show a long lasting product with a developer who cares about his product and customers.
Highly recommend this product and super responsive team.
The way you've answered questions and the history of your business gives me faith in its future.
Mr. Hans always supoorted very quickly.
I ask a question and get an answer from him within 10 minutes.
and the customer service is incredibly helpful.

themes.summary: Several buyers say stacking codes for more storage and unlimited models is affordable and good value.

hits.quote: the ability to stack extra codes for more storage (up to 10) made scaling my projects straightforward and affordable.
Because of satisfactory fast support, p3d is a very competitive price now, it is easy to use.
Just went for 10 codes to get the unlimited models premium plan!!

themes.summary: One buyer says the low-tier 1-2 code plan is too limited with only 1 model.

hits.quote: The deal does not really make sense to me on a 1 or 2 code plan.

themes.summary: One buyer dislikes that models are owned by the platform unless set as private.

hits.quote: I'm not too happy about the fact they own your models if you don't set them as a Private model.
